registered_before: any BL-152 result was read (its grid was still running)
support: at the NIFTY decision minute, the instrument's 1-minute close is beyond its own level of the same type as the variant's (built from its own bars); missing bar or level = not supporting
excluded: a day missing any of the three instruments entirely
comparison: D = mean net supported - mean net unsupported, BL-063 charges, 1 lot

control.kind: permutation of supported labels within a variant's trades

will_not_run: other support definitions (same direction since open, last 30 minutes)
a second look at the confirmation period
